title: Gate result, version 0
description: What a gate reports when it is run. Written as JSON. Every key is listed here: an unknown key is an error, so a misspelt one fails instead of being ignored. The outcome decides which other fields must be present, so a result cannot contradict itself.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the result follows. A reader that does not know the version must refuse the result.

gate.description: The name the gate has in the manifest.

outcome.description: `passed`: the command exited 0. `failed`: it exited non-zero. `timed_out`: it was stopped for running longer than the gate allows, so it has no exit code of its own. `skipped`: it was not run, and the reason says why. `deferred`: it could not be run where it was, and was left to the check on the pull request that the manifest names for it; the reason says why. A deferred gate is not a pass: it is a gate someone else must have seen pass.

command.description: The program and arguments that were run, as a list, with any toolchain wrapper already applied. For a skipped gate, the command that would have been run.

exit_code.description: The command's exit code. Present for `passed` and `failed`, absent otherwise.

duration_ms.description: How long the gate took, in milliseconds. Zero for a skipped gate.

ci_check.description: The check the gate was left to. Required for `deferred`, and present for nothing else.

reason.description: Why the gate was skipped or deferred. Required for both.

report.description: The gate's own structured result, when the manifest says it gives one (`result = "json"`). Its shape belongs to the gate, not to this schema.
